title: Length includes a power head, three wheelchair spaces
why: Same length basis problem, but 3 spaces meet the largest possible requirement (3 up to 300 m), so the answer is safe.

spec.name: Length includes a power head, three wheelchair spaces

wheelchair_spaces.required: ≥ 3 (at most, for a length up to 210 m)
wheelchair_spaces.rationale: Table 5 of point 4.2.2.2(1): whatever the power head's length, the true length is ≤ 210 m, which needs at most 3 spaces; 3 ≥ 3.
